verdict.rationale: Within ACS, agents act as registered counterparties. Sellers pick a specific agent, review its terms, and the agent must accept an approval request. A seller-initiated OCA is required before any data or checkout access, and orders are tagged and filterable by originating agent, with an `agent_details` field in private preview. This gives merchants a known-agent allowlist rather than anonymous traffic. Missing for 10: cryptographic agent signatures or request-level verification, trust tiers or reputation levels, any way to tell agent traffic from bots outside ACS (MPP/x402 machine payments show no agent identity check), GA status (agent_details and ACS are private preview), and independent corroboration.
